source: adsb.lol open data, readsb-prod-0 daily release (ODbL 1.0, https://www.adsb.lol/docs/open-data/historical)
license: ODbL 1.0 (a derived database of adsb.lol data)

method.classifier: gev-nic-nacp-v2 (God's Eye View, MIT): NACp < 8, or NIC < 7 except NIC 0 with NACp >= 10, or gpsOkBefore; ADS-B v1/v2; adsb_icao or mlat positions
method.aggregation: gpsjam.org: percent = 100 * (bad - 1) / aircraft per square per day; medium 2-10, high > 10
method.meaning: Aircraft reported low navigation accuracy. GPS jamming or spoofing is a common cause, not the only one.
